statusMessage: Celia Wren was found mutilated inside the abandoned Saint Orra Packing House. The investigation begins at 8:50 p.m.

sheriff_coroner_annex.name: Sheriff Hollis Cade
sheriff_coroner_annex.description: Hollowfield's broad-shouldered sheriff, visibly exhausted and protective of his jurisdiction.

sheriff_coroner_annex.name: Dr. Miriam Vale
sheriff_coroner_annex.description: The county medical examiner, precise and withdrawn behind round glasses.

saint_orra_packing.name: Gideon Rusk
saint_orra_packing.description: The packing house's scarred, gray-bearded caretaker and former union steward.

woh_radio.name: Naomi Venn
woh_radio.description: Celia's producer, sharp-eyed and raw with barely controlled grief.

town_hall.name: Mayor June Kessler
town_hall.description: Hollowfield's immaculate mayor, composed even under the weight of a public murder.

mercy_diner.name: Vera Bell
mercy_diner.description: The diner's steel-spined owner, watching the road through cat-eye glasses.

bell_farm.name: Dr. Amos Bell
bell_farm.description: A rangy farm veterinarian with windburned skin and an impatient manner.

saint_ledas_archive.name: Father Rowan Pike
saint_ledas_archive.description: A tired-eyed priest and guarded keeper of the church's labor archive.

northline_motel.name: Mae Orlov
northline_motel.description: The motel's glamorous, unsentimental owner, amused by other people's discomfort.

dredge_funeral_home.name: Silas Dredge
dredge_funeral_home.description: A gaunt, courtly mortician with the careful hands of an antiquarian.

evidence.title: The Saint Orra Body
evidence.summary: Radio journalist Celia Wren, 38, was found suspended and mutilated in the abandoned Saint Orra Packing House at 8:18 p.m.
